title: Act 1, Scene 1 — A desert place / 荒原
body: The Three Witches plan to meet Macbeth

title: Act 1, Scene 2 — A camp near Forres / 福里斯附近的營地
body: The battle is reported; Macbeth is praised by King Duncan

title: Act 1, Scene 3 — A heath near Forres / 福里斯附近的荒野
body: The Witches prophesy that Macbeth will be King

title: Act 1, Scene 4 — Forres. The palace / 福里斯，皇宮
body: Duncan names his son Malcolm as his heir

title: Act 1, Scene 5 — Inverness. Macbeth's castle / 因弗內斯，馬克白的城堡
body: Lady Macbeth reads the letter and calls upon dark spirits

title: Act 1, Scene 6 — Before Macbeth's castle / 馬克白的城堡前
body: King Duncan arrives at Inverness

title: Act 1, Scene 7 — Macbeth's castle / 馬克白的城堡
body: Macbeth's soliloquy and the decision to murder the King

title: Act 2, Scene 1 — Inverness. Macbeth's castle / 因弗內斯，馬克白的城堡
body: Banquo and Fleance; Macbeth's "dagger" soliloquy

title: Act 2, Scene 2 — Macbeth's castle / 馬克白的城堡
body: The murder of King Duncan

title: Act 2, Scene 3 — Macbeth's castle / 馬克白的城堡
body: The Porter; Macduff discovers the King's body

title: Act 2, Scene 4 — Outside Macbeth's castle / 馬克白的城堡外
body: Ross and an Old Man discuss unnatural events; Macbeth is named King

title: Act 3, Scene 1 — Forres. The palace / 福里斯，皇宮
body: Banquo's suspicions; Macbeth hires murderers

title: Act 3, Scene 2 — The palace / 皇宮
body: Macbeth and Lady Macbeth express their growing paranoia

title: Act 3, Scene 3 — A park near the palace / 皇宮附近的林地
body: The murderers kill Banquo, but Fleance escapes

title: Act 3, Scene 4 — The palace / 皇宮
body: The banquet scene; the ghost of Banquo appears to Macbeth

title: Act 3, Scene 5 — A heath / 荒野
body: Hecate scolds the Witches and plans to lead Macbeth to his doom

title: Act 3, Scene 6 — Forres. The palace / 福里斯，皇宮
body: Lennox and a Lord discuss Macbeth's tyranny; Macduff is in England

title: Act 4, Scene 1 — A cavern / 洞穴
body: Macbeth visits the Witches; they show him the three Apparitions

title: Act 4, Scene 2 — Fife. Macduff's castle / 法夫，麥克德夫的城堡
body: The murder of Lady Macduff and her young son

title: Act 4, Scene 3 — England. Before the King's palace / 英格蘭，皇宮前
body: Malcolm tests Macduff's loyalty; Ross brings news of the slaughter at Fife

title: Act 5, Scene 1 — Dunsinane. An ante-room / 鄧西嫩，城堡的前廳
body: Lady Macbeth's sleepwalking and the "Out, damned spot" scene

title: Act 5, Scene 2 — The country near Dunsinane / 鄧西嫩附近的鄉間
body: Scottish lords join the English army marching toward the castle

title: Act 5, Scene 3 — Dunsinane. A room in the castle / 鄧西嫩，城堡內的一間房
body: Macbeth's desperate defiance and report of his "mind diseased"

title: Act 5, Scene 4 — Country near Dunsinane: a wood / 鄧西嫩附近的鄉間：樹林
body: The English army camouflages themselves with branches from Birnam Wood

title: Act 5, Scene 5 — Dunsinane. Within the castle / 鄧西嫩，城堡內
body: Macbeth's "Tomorrow, and tomorrow, and tomorrow" soliloquy; news of Lady Macbeth's death

title: Act 5, Scene 6 — Dunsinane. Before the castle / 鄧西嫩，城堡前
body: The battle begins; Macbeth orders his men to fight

title: Act 5, Scene 7 — Another part of the field / 戰場的另一部分
body: Macbeth kills Young Siward in combat

title: Act 5, Scene 8 — Another part of the field / 戰場的另一部分
body: Macduff confronts Macbeth, reveals his birth by Caesarean section, and kills him
